newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce back in early morning.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced back in early morning trade on Tuesday, after the Nikkei average tumbled more than three percent the previous day. Brokers said the market had overreacted to a government official's comments on Monday, and buying back lifted the stocks.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 251.85 points or 1.40 percent to 18,295.67 in the first 15 minutes of trade. Its June futures rose 150 points to 18,240.
"The market was oversensitive yesterday," said Yasuo Ueki, general manager at Nikko Securities Co Ltd.
